outcome: composite neonatal morbidity (hypoglycemia, hyperbilirubinemia, shoulder dystocia, perinatal death)
cohort: Gravidae with pregestational diabetes who delivered a nonanomalous singleton at >=36 weeks between 2012 and 2022.
finding: Elective delivery at 36 weeks for gravidae with pregestational diabetes was associated with higher odds of composite neonatal morbidity, while delivery at 37 and 38 weeks showed no significant difference in composite morbidity compared to expectant management.
gest_age: Participants delivered at >=36 weeks; delivery timing was evaluated at 36, 37, and 38 weeks.
